title: Elimination of the parameters in an elliptic parametrization of the Schwarz primitive surface
summary: Let $Ω$ be the curvilinear square bounded by the four circular arcs $|ζ\mp1|=\sqrt{2}$, $|ζ\mp i|=\sqrt{2}$, and let $W=\sqrt{1+14ζ^{4}+ζ^{8}}$. Put \[ θ(ζ)=\arcsin\frac{2(1+i)ζ} {\sqrt{1+4iζ^{2}-ζ^{4}}}, \] \[ f=\tfrac14\bigl(-iF[θ,\tfrac14]+F[θ,\tfrac34]\bigr),\quad \quad g=\tfrac14\bigl(\ \ iF[θ,\tfrac14]+F[θ,\tfrac34]\bigr), \] \[ \mathfrak h=(2-\sqrt3)\, F\bigl[\arcsin\bigl(i(2+\sqrt3)ζ^{2}\bigr),(2-\sqrt3)^{4}\bigr]. \] These are, verbatim, the three functions of our companion paper $\mathrm{[D]}$ on the diamond surface $\mathrm{D}$: the two papers start from the same point, and differ…
